annotations.title: UK gender pay gap reports (employers of 250+)

description: The gender pay gap figures UK employers of 250 or more publish each year — employer, Companies House number, SIC codes, reporting year, mean and median hourly pay gap, mean and median bonus gap, the share of men and women paid a bonus and in each pay quartile, employer size band, due and submission dates and whether the report was late. By company number with history across years; from the official GOV.UK gender pay gap service, refreshed daily. The responsible person and the address are never ingested. Filters combine with AND; q searches all text fields. Costs 1 credit(s) per call with an API key; without one, a preview of up to 5 rows (30 calls/day).
name: query_uk_gender_pay_gap
